front: Fill a target with the anguish of violence so it takes mental damage when it acts hostilely.
back:
Will save.
Crit Success: unaffected.
Success: next time target takes a hostile action it takes 1d4 mental damage, then the spell ends.
Failure: first time each round target takes a hostile action, it takes 1d4 mental damage.
Crit Failure: each time it takes a hostile action, 1d4 mental damage.
Sustain up to 1 min.
Heightened (+1): +1d4 damage.
